newsitem.title: INDONESIA: Pertamina signs tanker deal with Indonesian firms.
newsitem.headline: Pertamina signs tanker deal with Indonesian firms.

text.p: Indonesia's state oil company Pertamina on Thursday signed agreements with state owned PT Dok Perkapalan Surabaya and privately-owned PT Jasa Marina Indah for the hire-purchase of four tankers.
Jasa Marina and Dok Perkapalan would build two tankers each with a capacity of 6,500 dwt each.
"The four tankers are part of Pertamina programme to add new vessels to its fleet," Pertamina's president director Faisal Abda'oe said at the signing ceremony.
He said Itochu Corp would finance the building of the tankers, which are expected to be completed in two years.
An Itochu official said the company would provide around $60 million in financing for building the tankers.
A Pertamina official said the firm will hire each tanker at a cost of $35.96 per dwt per month for eight years.
